newsitem.title: USA: N.J. Senate passes EZ Pass toll legislation.
newsitem.headline: N.J. Senate passes EZ Pass toll legislation.

text.p: A bill empowering state authorities to collect tolls electronically passed the state Senate on Monday.
The so-called EZ Pass system had been authorized already, but the Whitman administration was seeking the power to punish toll evaders electronically too.
The EZ Pass system enables motorists equipped with a special "black box" to pass through a toll booth and be charged a toll on a revolving account.
New Jersey's three autonomous authorities plan to install the system on the New Jersey Turnpike, Garden State Parkway and Atlantic City Expressway.
It is already in use on New York City bridges and tunnels operated by the Metropolitan Transit Authority and is being planned for Hudson River crossings, too.
The bill sent to the state Assembly on Monday would empower the state to photograph toll evaders and charges them $25 for each violation administratively, that is without a hearing.
